visualCharacteristics.notes: 4 tall portrait purple tiles in a horizontally scrolling row, optional image behind the text, clamped description, separate full-width Learn more bar with arrow below each tile; a standalone sculpture image (default content) sits beside the row

contentPattern: Cards (2 columns per row): cell 1 = image (may be empty); cell 2 = H3 title, description paragraph, 'Learn more' link. 4 rows.
